# Balancer V2 reference sources

Unmodified copies from [balancer/balancer-v2-monorepo](https://github.com/balancer/balancer-v2-monorepo)
at commit `e91a2b643a49856f51a648d175667c1b48cf3377`, licensed GPL-3.0-or-later (see `LICENSE`).

The arithmetic in these files has not changed since the pools exploited on
2025-11-03 were deployed: the later commits to `FixedPoint.sol` (2025-09) and
`StableMath.sol` (2023-03) change comments only.

They are the reference the Fe port in `ingots/balancer_v2` is checked against.
